gui.bluerecipebook.config.strictlyRequir:
Vanilla unlocks a recipe from a trigger. Planks unlock fences, even when you have not found sticks. Some mods unlock end-game crafting recipes at the start of the game.

───

§aOn:§r A recipe stays hidden until you had every ingredient in your inventory at least once.
gui.bluerecipebook.config.revealAllRecip:
§cOff:§r Only show unlocked recipes.

§aOn:§r List all existing recipes in the game, including ones you have not unlocked.

───

Temporarily overrides "Strictly require every ingredient".

You can return to your normal progression by disabling this setting.
gui.bluerecipebook.config.groupRecipes.d:
§aOn:§r Recipes that share a group share one slot. For example oak planks and birch planks group into wooden planks.

§cOff:§r Keeps all items apart. Different recipes that make the same item still share one slot.
gui.bluerecipebook.config.scrollToMoveIt:
§cOff:§r The scroll wheel turns pages.

§aOn:§r The scroll wheel places the required ingredients for the selected recipe into the crafting grid (like clicking), or takes them back.

───

Holding §7[ctrl]§r will temporarily invert the selected behavior.

Below the recipes, where the page navigation is, scrolling always turns pages.


§7Turning pages with the scroll wheel is a feature of this mod, not a vanilla behavior.
gui.bluerecipebook.config.openWhereYouLe:
§cOff:§r The book opens on the search tab, the first page, and an empty search.

§aOn:§r The book opens on the tab, page, and search text you left.
disconnect.bluerecipebook.newer_format:

Update the mod to keep this world's recipe progress.
Or delete this folder and start that data over:
"%s"
disconnect.bluerecipebook.unreadable_for:
